newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Klipton sells unit for 9.3 million rand.
newsitem.headline: Klipton sells unit for 9.3 million rand.

text.p: Klipton Ltd said on Thursday it had disposed of its unit Castor and Ladder (Pty) Ltd to the company's managing director for 9.3 million rand with effect from June 1.
The price will be paid in instalments over three years and would be used to reduce borrowings.
Klipton said had the sale been effective from July 1, 1996, its earnings per share for the six months ended December 31, 1996 would have increased by three cents to 26.5 cents.
Castor and Ladder manufactures and distributes a range of access and light materials handling equipment.
